description: Attribution judge validation set (D43). Real claims from the end-to-end execution run, plus seeded mismatches built from test claims.
selection: Pool: every cited claim and every supported corpus-wide finding in end-to-end run 1 (324). Shuffled with seed 43, at most 3 per question; first 20 = calibration, next 40 = test. Seed claims: 10 test claims per type, drawn with seed 4301.

seed_rules.invented_detail: The real claim with one invented, specific detail appended or inserted by hand; cited blocks unchanged.
seed_rules.wrong_block_same_company: The real claim; its citation replaced by the claim's 10th-nearest uncited chunk from the same company and section (resolved by scripts/export_attribution_set.py).
seed_rules.wrong_company_same_topic: The real claim; its citation replaced by the nearest chunk from a different company in the same section (resolved by the export script).
